title: The Counted Candles

steps.prompt: A coven counts its candles. The total is more than 0 and at most 60. When they group the candles, there are 2 left over when grouped in 3s, 3 left over when grouped in 4s, 4 left over when grouped in 5s. How many candles are there?

reveal_text: It beats out a number in the stone: 5.
